crossRefs.note: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”
When she pressed him daily with her words and urged him, his soul was troubled to death.
Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat…
When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.
For those who are such don’t serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering…
Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

translations.web: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
translations.bsb: My son, if sinners entice you, do not yield to them.
translations.kjv: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent
translations.asv: My son, if sinners entice thee, Consent thou not.
